correctness.rationale: Every subgroup of an odd-kernel generalized dihedral group is uniquely inside A or an outside Dih(C), with N/|C| outside subgroups for each C. Their automorphism orders follow from the characteristic odd-order subgroup and free reflection choice. Every endomorphism has either a reflection image and arbitrary A-endomorphism, or is trivial. The all-parity dihedral formula handles the extra C2-subgroup and D4 automorphism; the exact presentation count handles every homomorphism. Reproducible scripts independently check n=3..16 and Dih(C3×C3). Finite tests support but are not the infinite proof.

value.rationale: The exact infinite-family enumeration answers Cameron’s named nonabelian inequality question affirmatively on all ordinary dihedral groups and all odd-kernel generalized dihedral groups. The even-n correction isolates a genuine C2 isomorphism collision and exceptional Klein-four automorphism group; powers of two show the ratio of partial isomorphisms to endomorphisms is unbounded. These are full exact structural counts rather than isolated small improvements.
